components.name: Radio buttons
components.use: Single choice from a short list.

components.name: Text field
components.use: Text entry. Filled for dense forms, Outlined for low emphasis.

components.name: Docked input date picker [desktop]
components.use: Dropdown calendar under a field (large screens).

components.name: Loading indicator
components.use: Expressive shape-morph loader for short waits.

components.name: Standard slider
components.use: Pick a value on a range.

components.name: Button
components.use: Filled button: the one primary action on a screen.

components.name: Button - tonal
components.use: Secondary emphasis between filled and outlined.

components.name: Button - elevated
components.use: Needs separation from a patterned background.

components.name: Icon button togglable
components.use: Icon action with a selected state (favorite, bookmark).

components.name: Icon button togglable - tonal
components.use: Icon action with a selected state (favorite, bookmark).

components.name: Icon button togglable - outline
components.use: Icon action with a selected state (favorite, bookmark).

components.name: Icon button togglable - standard
components.use: Icon action with a selected state (favorite, bookmark).

components.name: FAB
components.use: The screen's most important action, floating.

components.name: Extended FAB
components.use: FAB with a label for clarity.

components.name: Split button
components.use: Main action + menu of related actions.

components.name: App bar
components.use: Top app bar: title, navigation and actions.

components.name: Bottom app bar
components.use: Bottom actions + FAB (being replaced by Toolbar in Expressive).

components.name: Navigation Bar: Vertical items
components.use: Bottom navigation with stacked icon + label.

components.name: Toolbar
components.use: Contextual actions for the current page.

components.name: Tabs
components.use: Switch between related views at the same level.

components.name: Stacked card
components.use: Content and actions about one subject, vertical.

components.name: Horizontal card
components.use: Compact card with media beside text.

components.name: List dialog
components.use: Choose from a list in a dialog.

components.name: Badges
components.use: Count or status dot on icons/nav items.

components.name: Carousel
components.use: Browse a collection of visual items.

components.name: Horizontal
issues: generic "Property 1"; set name should be Divider / Horizontal

components.name: Shape Set
components.use: M3 Expressive shapes for avatars, image masks, loaders.

components.name: Bottom sheet
components.use: Secondary content anchored to the bottom.

components.name: Side Sheet
components.use: Secondary content on the side (medium+ windows).

components.name: Snackbar
components.use: Brief message about a process, with optional action.
issues: one variant property has an empty name

components.name: Plain Tooltip
components.use: Short label for an icon or control.

components.name: Rich Tooltip
components.use: Tooltip with title, text and action.

components.name: Focus indicator
components.use: 3dp focus outline used by every interactive component.
